hebrewText: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח הָ/עָם֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה וַ/יִּשְׂא֣וּ מִ/שָּׁ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת יֹשֵׁ֣ב הַ/כְּרֻבִ֑ים וְ/שָׁ֞ם שְׁנֵ֣י בְנֵֽי עֵלִ֗י עִם אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים חָפְנִ֖י וּ/פִֽינְחָֽס

tokens.bdb: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).
tokens.explanation: shalach — enviar, mandar, despachar, estender a mão

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.kjv: folk, men, nation, people.
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum

tokens.bdb: Shiloh, a place in Palestine
tokens.kjv: Shiloh.

tokens.bdb: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
tokens.kjv: accept, advance, arise, (able to, (armor), suffer to) bear(-er, up), bring (forth), burn, carry (away), cast, contain, desire, ease, exact, exalt (self), extol, fetch, forgive, furnish, further, give, go on, help, high, hold up, honorable ([phrase] man), lade, lay, lift (self) up, lofty, marry, magnify, [idiom] needs, obtain, pardon, raise (up), receive, regard, respect, set (up), spare, stir up, [phrase] swear, take (away, up), [idiom] utterly, wear, yield.

tokens.bdb: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
tokens.kjv: in it, [phrase] thence, there (-in, [phrase] of, [phrase] out), [phrase] thither, [phrase] whither.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a box
tokens.kjv: ark, chest, coffin.

tokens.bdb: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)
tokens.kjv: confederacy, (con-) feder(-ate), covenant, league.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
tokens.kjv: appointed time, ([phrase]) army, ([phrase]) battle, company, host, service, soldiers, waiting upon, war(-fare).

tokens.bdb: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
tokens.kjv: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.

tokens.bdb: a cherub or imaginary figure
tokens.kjv: cherub, (plural) cherubims.

tokens.bdb: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
tokens.kjv: in it, [phrase] thence, there (-in, [phrase] of, [phrase] out), [phrase] thither, [phrase] whither.

tokens.bdb: two; also (as ordinal) twofold
tokens.kjv: both, couple, double, second, twain, [phrase] twelfth, [phrase] twelve, [phrase] twenty (sixscore) thousand, twice, two.

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
tokens.explanation: ben — filho, descendente, membro de um grupo (bar em aramaico)

tokens.bdb: Eli, an Israelite highpriest
tokens.kjv: Eli.

tokens.bdb: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
tokens.kjv: accompanying, against, and, as ([idiom] long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with(-al).

tokens.bdb: a box
tokens.kjv: ark, chest, coffin.

tokens.bdb: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)
tokens.kjv: confederacy, (con-) feder(-ate), covenant, league.

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: Elohim — nome hebraico de Deus. Plural de majestade. Denota o único Deus verdadeiro
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.bdb: Chophni, an Israelite
tokens.kjv: Hophni.

tokens.bdb: Pinechas, the name of three Israelites
tokens.kjv: Phinehas.
